source.note: Catalog join plus an intentionally partial source dispatcher inventory. 118 per-move item joins and 9 per-move ability joins remain unsupported; the 105-row King's Rock family, the 182-row Shell Bell family, exact nine Level-50 sSoundMovesTable selectors, source-proven absorbing candidates, 94 contact siblings, 182 Color Change siblings, 30 Synchronize status candidates, the one-row Attract/Oblivious family, the two-row Explosion/Damp family, and the 97-row Immunity status-cure family carry graph/program/source-handoff evidence. King's Rock retains Tickle as one explicit zero-damage exception; Shell Bell retains Future Sight as a distinct IGNORE_SHELL_BELL exception; no per-move oracle receipts are fabricated.

sourceExceptionRows.reason: MOVE_TICKLE carries FLAG_KINGS_ROCK_AFFECTED in the source table but power is 0 and its script performs no successful target datahpupdate, so gBattleMoveDamage/TARGET_TURN_DAMAGED cannot qualify.

item.reason: The King's Rock flinch family is source-proven for 105 of 106 finite flag-selected rows with Tickle retained as the zero-damage exception, and the Shell Bell heal family is source-proven for 182 of 183 finite power != 0 rows with Future Sight retained as the IGNORE_SHELL_BELL exception. Choice Band, target Evasion-up accuracy, and other held-item dispatchers remain unsupported/null per move.

target ability is ABILITY_SAND_VEIL and weather has sandstorm

routeShapeCensus.reason: Each Level-50 candidate is attached to one source-ordered graph/program entry block. Color Change and contact rows each carry a complete source/program route witness through a successful target datahpupdate and a state-3-capable moveend handoff; BIDE charge, Present healing, and Future Sight delayed bypasses remain explicit only where applicable.

sourceExceptionRows.reason: Future Sight's delayed hit performs target datahpupdate but BattleScript_FutureAttackEnd uses moveendfromto MOVEEND_ITEM_EFFECTS_ALL, MOVEEND_UPDATE_LAST_MOVES and therefore skips MOVEEND_ON_DAMAGE_ABILITIES state 3.

retiredBlockers.reason: Retired for the Color Change family: every supported Level-50 selector now carries a source/program route witness from its damaging entry (or BIDE release) through target datahpupdate to a Cmd_moveend handoff that reaches MOVEEND_ON_DAMAGE_ABILITIES. Future Sight is retained as an explicit source exception because its delayed handoff starts at MOVEEND_ITEM_EFFECTS_ALL.

Retired for the Color Change family: the family witness derives the selector power != 0 together with the ordered source guards for MOVE_RESULT_NO_EFFECT, MOVE_STRUGGLE, TARGET_TURN_DAMAGED, already-matching target type, and target survival; Cmd_datahpupdate is separately pinned as the positive non-passive damage-state writer. Present healing, misses/no-effect, and faint paths are explicit non-activation outcomes.

orderedGuards: AFFECTS_USER selects gBattlerAttacker as gEffectBattler and strips MOVE_EFFECT_AFFECTS_USER; otherwise gBattlerTarget is the effect battler

fainted effect battlers and substitutes block ordinary target status application
the primary-status switch applies type, ability, existing-status, and status immunity guards before statusChanged

primary.chance: primary status entries have no secondary chance roll; their source accuracy/status guards still apply

target.orientation: target helper reflects to gBattlerTarget by adding MOVE_EFFECT_AFFECTS_USER

attacker.orientation: attacker helper reflects to gBattlerAttacker without AFFECTS_USER

outcomeBoundaries: SetMoveEffect banks only poison, toxic, paralysis, and burn; sleep, freeze, and non-status effect bytes are excluded
source miss/no-effect, substitute, type, ability, Safeguard, Shield Dust, faint, existing-status, and status immunity guards can prevent banking or reflection

orderedGuards: AFFECTS_USER selects gBattlerAttacker as gEffectBattler and strips MOVE_EFFECT_AFFECTS_USER; otherwise gBattlerTarget is the effect battler
Shield Dust blocks non-primary status effects through MOVE_EFFECT_CERTAIN/primary guards
Safeguard blocks non-primary status effects through MOVE_EFFECT_CERTAIN/primary guards
fainted effect battlers and substitutes block ordinary target status application
the primary-status switch applies type, ability, existing-status, and status immunity guards before statusChanged
setMoveEffect.toxicReflection: ABILITYEFFECT_SYNCHRONIZE and ABILITYEFFECT_ATK_SYNCHRONIZE both strip MOVE_EFFECT_AFFECTS_USER | MOVE_EFFECT_CERTAIN and convert MOVE_EFFECT_TOXIC to MOVE_EFFECT_POISON before reflection

guards: Certain effects require !(gMoveResultFlags & MOVE_RESULT_NO_EFFECT)
secondary effects require Random() % 100 < percentChance and a nonzero MOVE_EFFECT_BYTE

miss/no-effect and no-effect status paths leave the effect unbanked

primary.chance: primary status entries have no secondary chance roll; their source accuracy/status guards still apply

target.orientation: target helper reflects to gBattlerTarget by adding MOVE_EFFECT_AFFECTS_USER

attacker.orientation: attacker helper reflects to gBattlerAttacker without AFFECTS_USER

outcomeBoundaries: SetMoveEffect banks only poison, toxic, paralysis, and burn; sleep, freeze, and non-status effect bytes are excluded
source miss/no-effect, substitute, type, ability, Safeguard, Shield Dust, faint, existing-status, and status immunity guards can prevent banking or reflection
